name: Naisho no Tintin Time
original_name: ないしょのティンティンたいむ
source:
A girl in a girls school drinks some experiment reagent in the mad scientist's laboratory. The next day she discovers a big cock in the toilet. Her friend advises to ejaculate in order to decrease the size. How long will will it take for the cure to be created?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名女校生在瘋狂科學家的實驗室裡喝了一些實驗試劑。第二天，她上廁所時發現自己長出了一根大雞巴。朋友建議她試試射精，看能不能讓雞巴變小。究竟還要等多久，才會有人找出治療的方法？
